replacements.Muescas en hueso (hueso de Ishango, Repú: Notches in bone (the Ishango bone, Democratic Republic of the Congo). The first separation between object and symbol: a mark is not the thing being counted, but its abstract, transferable, accumulable and communicable representation.

replacements.Babilonios y egipcios desarrollan sistem: Babylonians and Egyptians develop numeral systems and arithmetic rules for trade, astronomy and construction. The key: anyone who follows the same rules reaches the same result. Calculation is reproducible and impersonal.

replacements.Elementos: axiomas + pasos de deducción: Elements: axioms + valid deductive steps = necessarily true conclusions. For the first time, knowledge is produced through a reproducible formal process, not by authority or experience. The model still used in mathematics today.

replacements.Brahmagupta formaliza el cero y sus regl: Brahmagupta formalizes zero and its arithmetic rules (Brahmasphutasiddhanta, 628 CE). Zero completes the positional system: any quantity can be represented with only ten digits, and any operation can use the same uniform rules.
replacements.Hace posible la aritmética moderna y — 1: Makes modern arithmetic possible and — 1,300 years later — binary numeration
replacements.el 0 no vale nada — pero vale todo según: 0 is worth nothing — but its place changes everything
replacements.La Géométrie de Descartes unifica álgebr: La Géométrie by Descartes unifies algebra and geometry: a curve is an equation, a position is a pair of numbers. Geometric space becomes a calculable algebraic system. For the first time, the physical world can be manipulated through rules.
